title: Complete pluriclosed metrics with vanishing Bismut Ricci form on the affine quadric
summary: We study a one-parameter family of SO(4)-invariant pluriclosed Hermitian metrics $g_c$ with vanishing Bismut Ricci form on the affine quadric $Q_3\cong TS^3$, previously described in the physics literature. For every real parameter $c$, we prove local existence and uniqueness of a real-analytic solution to the defining singular initial-value problem, together with positivity of the associated metric near the singular orbit $S^3$.
